name: MONSTER X MEDIATOR
source:
WILL YOU BE THE FIRST HUMAN TO SURVIVE THIS SHADY JOB AT A SHADY HOTEL IN THE MIDDLE OF NOWHERE?

You've been hired as a mediator for a hotel because its guests refuse to vacate their rooms. The problem: They're all monsters.

From blackmailing to flirting anything is fair game when it comes to persuading these eccentric guests to leave their hotel rooms. Because you won't be allowed to leave until you do.

[From [url=https://headlocker.itch.io/monsterxmediator]Itch.io[/url]]
